packageRules.description: Grouped by which lockfile a bump forces you to regenerate. A per-package PR carries a partial lock, so the remaining members and their transitive fallout have to be re-derived by hand before it can merge — which is how these were being batched manually anyway. Over the first 71 days this repo saw 127 Renovate PRs; grouping this way would have made it 53.

maven_install.json is repinned as a whole by @<project>_maven_dependencies//:pin. PMD is the clearest case: pmd-core, pmd-java and pmd-cli ship from one release and resolve together, so three separate PRs each carried a change that could not be merged on its own.
go.sum is regenerated by `bazel run @rules_go//go -- mod tidy`.
Cargo.lock and the crate_universe lock are regenerated together by CARGO_BAZEL_REPIN=1 bazel fetch @crates//...
Bazel module bumps all land in one MODULE.bazel.lock refresh, so they group — except the modules carrying local patches, which are split out below.

Distroless images are digest pins on floating tags rebuilt continuously upstream — no versioned releases exist to render a changelog from. Link the source and say so in the PR body instead. Grouped because the digests refresh together and land in one MODULE.bazel.lock refresh.
prBodyNotes: **No changelog available**: distroless publishes digest-pinned floating tags with no versioned releases, so this digest cannot be mapped to release notes. Recent upstream changes: https://github.com/GoogleContainerTools/distroless/commits/main

packageRules.description: These four carry patches in tools/*/patches (see #9) and each needs the patch re-checked, or dropped, when it moves. Keeping them out of the bazel modules group stops one patched dependency blocking every other module bump — every PR for them so far has needed individual handling.

These hook revisions are not independent versions. The ruff hook must match aspect_rules_lint's ruff_bin, and clang-format must match llvm_version in tools/cpp/llvm_segment.MODULE.bazel; formatter output differs across versions, so a mismatch makes pre-commit and CI rewrite each other's files. Both move by hand in whichever PR moves the Bazel-side pin. Renovate cannot see those pairings — it proposed v0.16.5 and v23 against pins of 0.15.19 and 21.1.8, and both PRs were closed for it. The buildifier hook stays enabled: its trailing component is a release counter, so revs sharing a buildifier version format identically.
